text:
Sarah (AE): Hi team — Sequoia wants to run a week-long POC. They want to evaluate a customer-tuned "simian-70b" variant for conversational summarization + long-context retrieval. Main asks: private deploy (VPC+KMS), latency SLO ~120ms p95 for 1-2k tokens, and guidance on pricing. Can we do a quick preflight?
Eli (Solutions): Thanks Sarah. Quick checklist: model variant compatibility (kv-cache + q4_0 support), recommended quant profile, dedicated vs burst sizing, and a canonical prompt set for evals. Do they have sequence-length distribution?
Sarah (AE): They said typical sessions are 1.5k tokens, occasional 3k. Will share prompt set later today. They also asked about fallback to smaller models if tail latency spikes during business hours.
Mira (ML): Simian-70b tuning notes: the customer's variant uses custom RoPE scaling and residual adapters; we need to validate weight layout. For KV cache: simian-70b has a known kv-layout compatible with our runtime, but the tuned adapter might change memory profile. Recommend running our model-compat scan: `rwd-model-check --model simian-70b-cust --scan kv,ops,quant` (this is quick).
Eli (Solutions): If the scan passes, suggest a serving config: 1xdedicated pool with autoscale min=2 max=6 GPUs for baseline + burst. For latency 120ms p95 at 1.5k tokens we'll likely need 4xA100-ish equiv or a quantized variant. Options:
- run native float model on Dedicated (higher cost, best perf)
- run q4_0 quant variant (lower mem/cost, slightly higher latency variability)
- fallback to simian-35b-cpu-slim (warm fallback)
Tony (Infra): From infra side: private deployment requires customer's KMS key ARN and a short network runbook. Also need their VPC peering CIDRs. For Dedicated pricing ballpark: reserved pool (4 GPUs) -> estimate $22k/mo committed; burst/overage $X per GPU-hour (I'll DM finance exact). If they want guaranteed latency SLA we'll need to contract min capacity + 24/7 oncall (ent add-on).
Jules (Security): We'll need SOC2 + an encrypted-in-transit/in-rest confirmation. For KMS: we require key policy with cross-account decrypt for our infra role. Also send over their vendor security questionnaire; I'll pre-fill standard answers and flag any non-standard requirements.
Sarah (AE): Can you run the model-compat scan today, Mira? I'll upload the tuned weights to the secure S3 bucket once Sequoia confirms. Also want a short scoped runbook for Sequoia showing what we need from them.
Mira (ML): Starting scan now. If it fails on op-kernel mismatches we'll try our weight-adapter shim. ETA ~90m. If kv memory > 60GB we should recommend quantization or sharded KV.
Eli (Solutions): For the POC validation, propose these success metrics: 1) p95 latency <=120ms for 1.5k tokens (under expected load), 2) generation quality parity within 3% of baseline eval score, 3) zero sensitive-data leakage on 10 synthetic prompts. I'll draft the test harness.
Tony (Infra): Setup notes for the customer: snippet for KMS role binding:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_poc" {
  name = "redwood-poc-decrypt"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.trust.json
}
# Provide this role ARN to customer for key policy
```
Also we need a CIDR allowlist for control-plane endpoints.
Sarah (AE): Sequoia asked about pricing tiers — can they start hosted then move to private? They prefer starting in Hosted to speed POC but need VPC for sensitive data.
Eli (Solutions): Yes — we can do a hybrid: run ingest + eval in Hosted (sandbox) and then lift to Private with their KMS once baseline is good. Note: canonical prompt set must be deterministic to avoid eval variance.
Mira (ML): Scan finished: small op mismatch on custom rotary patch — not fatal. I can run a quick conversion that preserves weights and yields a compatible kernel layout. Also memory peak for 1.5k tokens ~58GB with kv; recommend q4_0 to hit <40GB.
Jules (Security): Quick note — if they require customer-managed HSM (not just KMS), that adds a 3-week onboarding and contract clause. Flagging now.
Eli (Solutions): Next steps: 1) Sarah to get weights + prompt set; 2) Tony to prepare private-deploy runbook + CIDR/KMS checklist; 3) Mira to produce a quick perf/compat report and an advice doc on quant tradeoffs; 4) Jules to pre-fill security answers and highlight HSM risk.
Sarah (AE): I'll collect items from Sequoia and loop back by EOD. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled model-compat-scan job 1738675310 started on runner-9.
Eli (Solutions): Also adding a short curl example for their ops team to smoke-test once we have a working endpoint:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"simian-70b-cust-compat","input":"Summarize:\n\n[long conversation...]","max_tokens":512}'
```
Mira (ML): I'll attach the perf numbers to the ticket once conversion completes. If conversion looks flaky we can propose simian-70b-lite as a stopgap.
Tony (Infra): I'll ping finance and include a firm quote for reserved 4-GPU pool + 20% buffer.
Sarah (AE): Perfect — reopening this thread when I have Sequoia's artifacts. Thanks all.
